subject: COLUMN clause
notes: kb/Work PB1059: COBOL2710 refuses a COLUMN operand (absolute column or relative offset) greater than the page width, written or assumed. || editions corrected from '85' to 85,2002,2014,2023 (kb/Work PB3173, S0b; DESIGN-conformance-suite.md §6 step 0): a facility that exists at every edition (the COBOL-85 nucleus, I-O, inter-program and SPECIAL-NAMES implementor-names; its arithmetic, the only arithmetic of COBOL-85, is what later editions name native).
